name: Ruou can
summary: The Vietnam Tourism coolcation article names rượu cần and calls it locally brewed fermented glutinous rice wine, drunk around a fire at night. The discover article describes homemade wine through a long bamboo straw. A strength and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den. Báo Kon Tum names rượu cần at the cultural-night meal. Vietnam Tourism also names traditional home-made wine at Konbring village, without the words rượu cần on that line.
culture: Vietnam Tourism ties the bamboo-straw wine to a ceremony, with gongs, drums, flutes, and string instruments. The coolcation article puts rượu cần around a fire at night, with gongs.
howToEat: The discover article: drink homemade wine through a long bamboo straw.
The coolcation article: rượu cần is fermented glutinous rice wine, around a fire at night.
Báo Kon Tum serves rượu cần with cơm lam, gà nướng, thịt xiên, and bánh nếp at the cultural night.
A strength is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Tourism names traditional home-made wine at Konbring village and does not print the words rượu cần on that line.
Báo Kon Tum places rượu cần at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”.
A later Báo Kon Tum article names wine products at a center stall of the weekend market and does not print rượu cần for that stall.
